M-FLEXBOX.Purpose: Dependency-free C# port of the Yoga Flexbox layout engine: compute node measurements from styles over the full box model.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Flex calculation entry points: CalculateLayout with width/height modes.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Node/Style data model, default node creation, style copy, reset. Precision helpers: FloatsEqual, RoundValueToPixelGrid. Extensions bridging FlexVerse length/align types onto flex styles. Mapping widget properties onto styles — owned by SS-WIDGET-RUNTIME.

Requirements.REQ-001: CalculateLayout is deterministic for identical node/style inputs per SS-FLEXBOX.REQ-001.
Requirements.REQ-002: No reference to Unity, RimWorld or FlexVerse widget types.

Inputs.IN-001: node: Node — root of the layout subtree.

Outputs.OUT-001: computed node layout (position/size) across the subtree.
